open_issues.title: Rustdoc for “macros” feature is incomplete
open_issues.body:
**Version**
1.54.1

**Description**
In the front page of the rustdoc, the following description of the `macros` feature appears:

> `macros`: Enables `#[tokio::main]` and `#[tokio::test]` macros.

This is not true. It also enables other macros, at least `tokio::select` ([cite](https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/macro.select.html)), and maybe others as well.
